content: Such an author characterization score has many possible applications. With the ability to identify the most/least characteristic tweets from a person, we can generate reduced excerpts for high-volume Twitter profiles. Similarly, identifying the least characteristic tweets can highlight unusual content or suspicious activity. A run of sufficiently unrepresentative tweets might be indicative that a hacker has taken control of a user's account.
